pli-tv-bu-vb-sk45:1.3.1: According to Sp 2.621 this means repeatedly breaking pieces off a ball of food. The word _avacchedaka_ is further explained at Vin-vn-ṭ 1920 as _chinditvā_, “having broken off”. This, it seems, can only refer to breaking off pieces, not to biting. Each ball of food was a single mouthful, consisting of rice with suitable curry.
